verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party library of ready-made project templates. It contains only quickstart code snippets, an interactive playground that generates request code, and an AI-assistant skill package, none of which is a template library. The one-click Docker setups come from a community-built third-party hub (crawl4ai.dev), not the product itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
